notes.title: This is Gnaughty Gnomes (Devlog 1)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're Sand Castles Studio, a small indie team of 8 people. Three years ago, we developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607680/Bread__Fred/][b]Bread & Fred[/b][/url], the co-op game where two penguins climb a mountain while tied together with a rope.

In February, we announced our new multiplayer game: [b]Gnaughty Gnomes[/b]. Yep, it's a game about gnomes, but these gnomes fight to the death! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477024/d02baeb45bf6dabd366f7dbadaaeb44c57986520.jpg[/img]

This time, we're here to share some updates on its development in this first devlog (more to come!): how we came up with the idea, what the game's all about, and what you can expect from the gameplay.

[h3][b]How did it all start?[/b][/h3]

One random afternoon, we came across [b]Bloodroots[/b], that fast-paced game where you can use almost anything in the environment as a weapon. And that sparked a question: ''What if the characters were [b]gnomes[/b]? And what if they started brawling with whatever they could grab?''

That's how our new project was born: a [b]chaotic multiplayer game[/b] for 2 to 4 players, where matches are quick, the maps are tight, and the goal is simple: be the last gnome standing.

[previewyoutube=RXRRphn2cRk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]What can you do in Gnaughty Gnomes?[/b][/h3]

▪️Throw ANYTHING you find on the ground
▪️Punch your enemies in +20 themed maps
▪️Choose between +120 skill cards 
▪️Dodge like a ninja
▪️Taunt your friends with goofy emotes

In a nutshell, we could say that Gnaughty Gnomes is a mix between Bloodroots, Party Animals, Rounds and Boomerang Fu.

[h3][b]Chaos... with upgrades[/b][/h3]

After a couple of rounds, each player gets to choose [b]a random upgrade[/b] from hundreds of options. Some are useful, others are... well, completely chaotic. But they all shake up the gameplay. And once everyone has a few upgrades stacked, the match turns into a full-on festival of chaos and laughs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477024/2bce2a3b54ec8dcb9444ba6ffcdaa7ac08c6745e.jpg[/img]

If you like the game, you can[b] try its demo and add it to your wishlist [/b]to help us give it more visibility.

We'll keep sharing our progress through more devlogs. Stay tuned!

And stay in touch with us through [url=https://linktr.ee/SandCastlesStudio][b]our social media[/b][/url].

See you soon!

notes.title: Gnaughty Gnomes demo is out now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Gnaughty Gnomes demo[/b] is now available and you can try it for free starting today.

[h2]👊 Become a fighting gnome![/h2]

Gnaughty Gnomes is a very crazy and frantic[b] party game[/b] in which you:

🔹 Use any object on the stage as a weapon.
🔹 Choose cards of different rarities. 
🔹 Fight on themed maps 
🔹 Customize your gnome
🔹 Taunt your enemies with gestures.

[previewyoutube=D4AJXis_yO4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]🎮 What's included in the demo?[/h2]

In this [b]first playable version[/b] you can enjoy:

🔹 10 different maps (5 Aquarium and 5 Airport)
🔹 45 upgrade cards with different synergies (the final version will have more than 100)
🔹 15 customization options per body part
🔹 3 win games, with upgrade selection between each round

[h2]🛠️ We want your feedback[/h2]

This demo is very important to us. We would love to know [b]what you think [/b]about the game. If you feel like it, leave us your comments, ideas, funny clips or bugs you find in the community forum or [b][url=https://discord.gg/5z2bnKQw]on our Discord[/url][/b].

[h2]☺️ Thanks for your support[/h2]

If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add Gnaughty Gnomes [b]to your wishlist[/b]. You will help us a lot and you will be up to date with all the news.

Remember that you can also follow us on [b][url=https://linktr.ee/SandCastlesStudio]our social networks[/url][/b].

See you soon!
